tools.name: create_data_asset
tools.description: Create a new Data Asset instance of a specific class (e.g. UPrimaryDataAsset or a custom Blueprint data asset class). Useful for structural game data like item properties, character stats, or ability definitions.

asset_path.description: Content path for the new Data Asset (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_IceSword')

class_name.description: Class name or path of the Data Asset subclass (e.g. 'UMyItemData' or '/Game/Blueprints/BP_ItemData.BP_ItemData_C')

tools.name: set_data_asset_properties
tools.description: Set property values on an existing Data Asset via reflection. Property values are parsed as strings (e.g. '120.5', 'true', '(R=1,G=0,B=0,A=1)' for color, or asset path strings for object references).

asset_path.description: Content path of the target Data Asset (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_IceSword')

properties.description: Key-value pairs of exact property names and their string-serialized values.

tools.name: get_data_asset_info
tools.description: Inspect and retrieve the current properties, types, and values of a Data Asset as JSON. Use this to understand the structure of a class instance before editing properties.

asset_path.description: Content path of the Data Asset to inspect
